answer_verbatim:
The **best online courses** for learning shadow work and spiritual practice, based on the results provided, are the ones that combine **Jungian shadow work**, **guided exercises**, and a clear **practice structure** rather than only theory.[3][7][15]

- **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform is the strongest fit if you want a serious, psychology-based course focused on Jungian shadow work.[3][7]
- **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** from ManTalks is a good option if you want an **8-week guided process** with journaling and self-discovery practices.[20][1]
- **Embracing The Shadow** with Charlie Morley on Awake Academy is a strong pick if you want a more explicitly **transformational and spiritual** approach.[18]
- **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** on Udemy may suit learners who want a mix of lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and workbook-style practice for spiritual transformation.[14]
- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on Udemy is another broad option aimed at healing, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[2]
- **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** from Centre of Excellence is a more structured self-paced course framed around Jungian psychology and personal development.[5]

If you want the **most credible starting point**, I would prioritize **Jung Platform** for depth and **Charlie Morley / Awake Academy** or **ManTalks** for a more practice-oriented spiritual path.[3][7][18][20]

A simple way to choose:
- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want **psychological depth** and Jungian foundations.[3][7]
- Choose **ManTalks** if you want **guided reflection and journaling**.[20][1]
- Choose **Awake Academy** if you want **spiritual transformation** alongside shadow work.[18]
- Choose **Udemy** if you want a **lower-cost, flexible** self-paced format with lots of exercises.[2][14][16]

If you want, I can also turn these into a **ranked shortlist by budget, depth, and spiritual focus**.
